paper_metadata.title: Investigation on solution heat treatment response and γ' solvus temperature of a Mo-rich second generation Ni based single crystal superalloy

evidence.quote: A multi-step solution heat treatment regime of a Mo-rich Ni based single crystal superalloy (Alloy Mo) was designed
with regard to multi-component SC superalloy, different alloying elements had different responses to SHT, which was closely related with solid phase diffusion occurred during SHT.
as-cast Alloy Mo with relatively low microsegregation degree of Re element
especially in some W-rich SC superalloys, e.g. in the W-rich (8.0 wt%) 2nd generation SC superalloy DD6
Influence of solution heat treatment on both solidus temperature and γ0 solvus temperature in Mo-rich single crystal superalloys were lower than those of in W-rich single crystal superalloys.
The experimental alloy used in this work was a Mo-rich second generation Ni based SC superalloy with the nominal composition of Ni-6.5Al – 10Co – 3Cr – 7Mo – 5Ta-3Re (in wt%, namely Alloy Mo).
